data.name: Bwa Chik Hotel & Golf
data.description:
Overlooking Golf International de St François, this upscale hotel is a 12-minute walk from Plage des Raisins Clairs and 10.7 km from Pointe des Châteaux.
Beachy, rustic-chic rooms with tile floors have Wi-Fi (fee), TVs and terraces. Duplex rooms add lounges and pull-out sofas, plus golf course or pool views. Kids 11 and under stay free in their parents’ room.
Continental breakfast (fee) is served on a covered terrace alongside the outdoor pool. There’s also a cocktail bar with weekly jazz nights. Other fee-based amenities include babysitting services and shuttle service to the Golf International de St François golf course.
